title: Seven Shades of Evil
author: McCammon, Robert
review: Great collection of well plotted and entertaining short stories with brilliant writing. McCammon is my guy!! None are absolutely essential to the overall plot of the series but we do get some good moments with characters we don't regularly see in the main series as well as go a little bit outside the lines and have some fun with different types of stories.
